description: Power outage risk forecast — Power-outage risk for a US location over the next 6-72 hours from National Weather Service data: peak wind gusts, ice accretion, heavy/wet snow load, thunderstorm chance, rain-saturated ground and active NWS alerts (High Wind, Ice Storm, Blizzard, Severe Thunderstorm, Tornado, Hurricane...) combined into a 0-100 score and LOW/ELEVATED/HIGH/SEVERE level with drivers, peak gust time, ice/snow/rain totals, the worst 6-hour periods and a preparedness recommendation. Params: place= (city, address or ZIP) or lat=&lon=; optional hours= 6-72 (default 48). Heuristic estimate, not a utility outage forecast. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_outage_risk
